USB package (14 Oct 2026; distribution only, the module source and version are unchanged): loads over USB on the Modwerk beta base as an independent machine package. Its chooser row, page and renderer go through the base’s machine table, and its 909/808 DSP engine is resident in the base on both cores. The base admits this exact package through a trust row built into it; its renderer writes only under the base’s write lease and renders silent until the base has reset and enabled the engine, whose reset restores its authored tables. It needs that exact base; with an older base the site asks for a base update first. Its compiled bytes that coincide with stock are copied at install from bytes the base checks against its running stock, so the package carries no stock bytes.

USB package limits: removing it converts its tracks back to FLEX in every known Part copy and fails closed otherwise. Host tests only (the base’s reset, enable, lease and removal against a modelled DSP receiver); no emulator or hardware run of this package. The owner waived hardware evidence for this exact version’s USB package for the beta.

Site sync on the beta base (beta test run 2, 14 Oct 2026; the package is unchanged): removing it while its controller runs no longer ends the sync with “The Octatrack refused this step.” The base answers the first removal busy while it stops the controller and drops the staged package; the site now stages it again, as it does for the base's other busy refusals. Checked on a development twin through the development link (Sidechain installed, running, removed in one command) and by the site's tests; the site's own path has not run on the unit yet.
